{
  "type": "bash",
  "content": "#!/bin/bash

# Script to test each discovered URL for basic SQL injection by injecting a single quote and checking for error messages.

URLS_FILE="urls_with_params.txt"
OUTPUT_FILE="sqli_test_results.txt"

# Clear previous results file
> "$OUTPUT_FILE"

# Common DB error patterns to look for
ERROR_PATTERNS="SQL syntax|SQL error|database error|ORA-|SQLite|MySQL|PostgreSQL|Microsoft OLE DB Provider|ODBC"

while IFS= read -r url; do
  # Parse the base URL and its query string
  base="${url%%\?*}"
  query="${url#*\?}"

  # Build a modified query with a single quote appended to each parameter value
  modified_query=""
  IFS='&' read -ra params <<< "$query"
  for param in "${params[@]}"; do
    key="${param%%=*}"
    value="${param#*=}"
    # Append a single quote to the value
    new_value="${value}'"
    if [ -z "$modified_query" ]; then
      modified_query="${key}=${new_value}"
    else
      modified_query="${modified_query}&${key}=${new_value}"
    fi
  done

  test_url="${base}?${modified_query}"
  # Fetch the page
  response=$(curl -s -L "$test_url")
  # Check for error patterns
  if echo "$response" | grep -Ei "$ERROR_PATTERNS" > /dev/null; then
    echo "[VULN] $test_url" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
  else
    echo "[SAFE] $test_url" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
  fi
done < "$URLS_FILE"

# Return to AI to summarize findings
return_to_ai="cat $OUTPUT_FILE"",
  "script_name": "test_sqli.sh",
  "script_type": "bash",
  "reason": "Inject single quotes into each parameter to detect basic SQLi error-based vulnerabilities.",
  "output_name": "sqli_test_results.txt",
  "vuln": "sql_injection_recon",
  "knowledge_ref": "references.xss.type.reflected",
  "continue": "true"
}
